entries.9b7e59337b0b0e73: This business operates a chain of supermarkets selling mainly foodstuffs and is the core of the group. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥294,769 million. As of March 31, 2026, there were 131 stores: 71 in Niigata Prefecture, 44 in Gunma Prefecture, 6 in Nagano Prefecture, 4 in Toyama Prefecture, 3 in Tochigi Prefecture and 3 in Saitama Prefecture. There are also 100-yen shops, but these are not included in this store count. Three companies, Harashin, Narus and Fressei, operate the stores, while separate subsidiaries handle the consolidation of procurement and indirect operations, food manufacturing and processing, development of in-house products, online sales and real estate management.
entries.ea3bdfa670f7f636: A category not included in the reportable segments, covering businesses such as information processing, cleaning and printing. Hara Kōsan handles cleaning and insurance agency operations for group companies, Itec handles information processing and software development, and Kōsoku Insatsu creates and delivers printed materials such as flyers. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥767 million, and transactions are mainly within the group.
